description: 3D z-axis extruded circular cylinder, infinite span (z-periodic), Re=40. Steady wake (below shedding threshold). Cd from the Ladd momentum-exchange (MEM) force restricted to the SURFACE solid cells (see docs/mem_surface_caliber_finding.md).
geometry: z-axis extruded circular cylinder, infinite span (z periodic)

reference.convention: 3D extruded + z-periodic == 2D infinite span; correct comparison is the 2D free-stream NUMERICAL cluster, not finite-span experiment (Tritton 1.54).

force_method: Ladd MEM, surface-only: sum over solid cells adjacent to fluid (6-neighbourhood). The all-solid sum carries a non-degenerate pseudo-force from interior voxel cells; restricting to the surface layer recovers the correct value. Three calibers reported.
reproduction: PYTHONPATH=src python benchmarks/verified/cylinder_3d/run.py single 20 --steps 30000 --lateral 40 --nz 1 --device sdaa:0 --compile-mode eager
